English: Bocas Del Toro is a small strip of land between Costa Rica and Colombia, which we've both laid claim to, however, if we dispatch explorer Juan Galindo to the area we can justify our expansion into the region, Columbia may however, still demand this area if we attempt to incorporate it into our nation.
